Your holdings: SMCI (-42.97%), SOXL (-78.3%), and MUU (-60.85%) are deep in the red and need attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on the semiconductor ETF SOXL and its leveraged cousin SOXS. Also, watch the broader tech index QQQ.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply underwater leveraged positions and the core tech names.
plays: Trim SMCI: It's a SELL and deep in the red. Consider reducing exposure.
Trim SOXL: Deep losses here. Evaluate if the leveraged decay is worth the risk.
Consider new buy: MSFU (entry 39.13-39.08, stop 38.92) has a Grade C bias but is in a daily discount and 1H order block.
